title_original: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the procedures for creating family relations registers under Article 4-2 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of Persons of Distinguished Service to Independence.
